bellatrix 3.2.0 - model-free UI automation CLI (output is always JSON).

Usage: bellatrix <init|sessions|version|help> [--flag value] | bellatrix config <show|validate> | bellatrix <desktop|web|mobile> <verb> [--flag value] | bellatrix <domain> help

Commands:
  init (alias: update-skills)
      Scaffold the BELLATRIX skills, subagents and instruction fragment for your AI agent(s) into this repo.
      --agent <a[,b,...]>            AI agent(s) to scaffold for, comma-separated (windsurf = devin, agy = antigravity).Default: the agents already scaffolded, else the one detected from repo markers. (one of: claude|copilot|cursor|devin|codex|gemini|antigravity|kiro|opencode)
      --target <a[,b,...]>           Legacy spelling of --agent.
      --language <language>          BELLATRIX flavor. Default: the recorded language, else detected from build files, else csharp. (one of: csharp|java|typescript)
      --domains <d[,d,...]>          Domains to scaffold. (default: desktop,web,mobile; one of: desktop|web|mobile)
      --out <dir>                    Repository root to scaffold into. (default: current directory)
      --regenerate                   Overwrite files you edited (otherwise they are skipped and reported).
      --force                        Legacy spelling of --regenerate.
      --dry-run                      Report what would be written; change nothing.
      --template-source <dir>        Render your own template folder (same layout as the built-in templates) instead of the BELLATRIX templates.
      --prefix <prefix>              Namespace for --template-source output (skills, agents, fragment, manifests). Default: inferred from the folder.

      --test-cases-dir <dir | d=dir,...> Folder of your test-case files ({dir}/{suite}/TC-{id}.md), or

result.stdout:
bellatrix 3.2.0 - model-free UI automation CLI (output is always JSON).

Usage: bellatrix sessions [--flag value]

Commands:
  sessions
      List the persisted sessions of every domain, or prune stale ones.
      --list                         Report the sessions (the default).
      --prune                        Delete sessions idle longer than the keep-alive TTL and stop their local web drivers.

Every command also accepts --json (no effect) and --no-interaction (never prompt; only init prompts, in a terminal).
Exit codes: 0 = Success; the success JSON on stdout is the contract.; 1 = Error; stdout is {"error":{"code","message"}} (e.g. usage, unknown_verb, session_not_found, driver_unreachable).; 2 = Usage error in agent, language or project selection (init: unknown/ambiguous --agent, --language or test project; a bad --project / --test-cases-dir).
Machine-readable: bellatrix help --json (or bellatrix <domain> help --json).
